description:
Cast Tippy-Toe by paying its mana cost.
When Tippy-Toe enters, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Tippy-Toe with haste plus at least one additional token due to Tippy-Toe's effect.
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}.
When Kirol enters, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, use the ability of Earthcraft to tap one of the Tippy-Toe tokens, adding {1}.
Activate Kirol by tapping two creatures, copying Cadric's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, creating at least eight tokens due to the multiple copies of Tippy-Toe.
Holding priority, use the ability of Earthcraft to tap one of the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 6.
